def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    equity_market_value = 150
    debt_market_value = 100
    cost_of_equity = 0.09
    cost_of_debt = 0.05
    tax_rate = 0.25

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_value = equity_market_value + debt_market_value
    equity_weight = equity_market_value / total_value
    debt_weight = debt_market_value / total_value
    after_tax_cost_of_debt = cost_of_debt * (1 - tax_rate)

    wacc = (
        equity_weight * cost_of_equity
        + debt_weight * after_tax_cost_of_debt
    )

    # Return answer as a percentage rounded to two decimal places
    answer = round(wacc * 100, 2)
    return answer
